verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API specification. What is documented is related but different: llms.txt, markdown docs, MCP servers, and a CLI that lets you "inspect schemas" interactively. None of these is a published spec file, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
